validation_notes:
Processed 9 people from ABIO CSV. Checked 2 local ABIO documents: annual report 2024 and IFRS 2024. Completed 1 research round per person, 9 person-rounds total, with parallel Agent 1 searches and final synthesis/soft validation. CEO confirmed: Масюк Сергей Владимирович. Local annual report confirms 2024 board composition but conflicts with CSV for Александров Дмитрий Андреевич: CSV includes him, while the 2024 annual report does not; current Artgen page and 2025 disclosure mirror suggest later/current board composition, so his 2024 board role is marked as unconfirmed. Education not fully identified for Масюк: only higher education is confirmed. Scientific/patent metrics remain incomplete for Исаев Артур, Деев, and Киселев: publications or patent authorship are partly confirmed, but h-index and full patent registers were not verified. Weak/auxiliary sources were used only for corroboration for Мауэр and Примак. Namesakes excluded: unrelated Масюк profiles, Артур vs Андрей Исаев cross-contamination, unrelated Sergey Kiselev profiles, and Дмитрий Валерьевич Александров/other Дмитрий Александров profiles. Search considered complete because local documents, official Artgen/e-disclosure sources, issuer reports, current official pages, prior employer/company sources, university/scientific profiles, PubMed/dissertation sources, business registries, Russian and English name queries, and two follow-up search passes were checked without new higher-quality unresolved leads.

ROUND 2 (2026-07-18, gap-fill + GICS + qualification_degree + institution normalization):

1) Gap-fill research (web, targeted at fields that were null/vague after round 1): Масюк's university remained unconfirmed after searching roscongress.org, an official Skolkovo-gymnasium interview, and an Artgen YouTube history video -- no source discloses his alma mater, so education[0].institution stays null and qualification_degree is set to "Unknown" (higher education is a confirmed fact, but its level/field is not). Богуславский's Кандидат экономических наук defending institution was searched via WebFetch on the dissercat record and further queries (hub.sfedu.ru dissertation lists, disserCat catalog) -- location "Ростов-на-Дону, 2003" is confirmed but the specific dissertation council/university is not, so degrees[0].institution stays null (not guessed, even though his listed alma mater Южный федеральный университет is a plausible but unconfirmed candidate). Деев's and Киселев's h-index were searched directly (elibrary/Scopus/general web) -- no numeric value is published in any indexed source reachable by search, so h_index stays null for both. Примак's stock-market career at Тройка Диалог/Альфа-Банк remains unconfirmed (only АТОН corroborated, via wiki.letopis.ru, without dates) -- not added as dated jobs, consistent with round-1 caution.

2) GICS sector/industry_group/industry added at company level (Health Care | Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences | Biotechnology, matching Artgen's own description as a Russian biotech group) and to every professional_experience entry for all 9 people, copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json. Methodology: each organization's OWN primary business was checked (web search/registry lookup where not already obvious from prior research), not the person's role. Artgen-group entities (ПАО "Артген"/ИСКЧ, ООО "ИСКЧ Фарма"/"НекстГен Фарма", Институт Стволовых Клеток Человека) = Biotechnology. Genetic-diagnostics/reproductive-medicine labs delivering services directly to patients (ПАО/ООО "ЦГРМ "ГЕНЕТИКО") = Health Care Providers & Services. ПАО "ММЦБ"/Гемабанк (stem-cell biobanking + fledgling gene-therapy R&D, confirmed via web search) = Life Sciences Tools & Services, distinguished from Artgen's core Biotechnology label because its historic core business is biobank storage/services rather than drug commercialization. Clinics/hospitals/medical research institutes providing patient care (Европейская Международная Клиника, Диалайн, ВМА им. Кирова/НИИ Вредена, ФНКЦ ФХМ ФМБА) = Health Care Providers & Services. Degree-granting universities/academies, even medical or financial ones (РязГМУ, Институт Финансово-Инвестиционных Технологий -- confirmed via search as a trading/investing course provider) = Consumer Discretionary/Consumer Services/Diversified Consumer Services, distinguished from clinical institutions by the fact that the professional_experience role itself is a teaching/founding-of-courses role, not patient care. Audit/consulting entities around Мауэр (Мауэр-Аудит, MauerGroup, МауэрГруппРостов, МауэрИнвест, ИСКЧ Консалтинг) = Professional Services -- confirmed via registry search that ООО "МауэрИнвест" and ООО "ИСКЧ Консалтинг" both carry ОКВЭД 70.22 (management/business consulting), not a financial-services code, despite the "Инвест" name.
